scripts.dev: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && vite
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && vite
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace @frontier-isles/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:game && tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.typecheck:server: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @frontier-isles/realtime-contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @frontier-isles/server
scripts.test: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && vitest run && npm run test --workspace @frontier-isles/game-core && npm run test --workspace @frontier-isles/game-ai
scripts.test:server: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @frontier-isles/realtime-contracts && npm run test --workspace @frontier-isles/server
scripts.test:recovery: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && npm exec --workspace @frontier-isles/server -- vitest run test/multiplayer-repository.test.ts test/multiplayer-recovery.test.ts test/multiplayer-restart.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:security: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && npm exec --workspace @frontier-isles/server -- vitest run test/security-limits.test.ts test/security-http.test.ts test/security-wire.integration.test.ts test/security-storage.test.ts test/security-artifacts.test.ts
scripts.test:load: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && npm exec --workspace @frontier-isles/server -- vitest run test/alpha-load.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:server: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @frontier-isles/server
scripts.e2e:audit: playwright test tests/e2e/lobby.spec.ts tests/e2e/online-delivery.spec.ts tests/e2e/online-game.spec.ts tests/e2e/online-workflows.spec.ts tests/e2e/online-presence.spec.ts tests/e2e/online-seating.spec.ts tests/e2e/online-restart.spec.ts --trace on
scripts.e2e:online: playwright test tests/e2e/online-game.spec.ts tests/e2e/online-workflows.spec.ts tests/e2e/online-delivery.spec.ts tests/e2e/online-presence.spec.ts tests/e2e/online-seating.spec.ts tests/e2e/online-restart.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:server: npm run build:game && npm run build:contracts && tsx tests/e2e/realtime-test-server.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:server: npm run typecheck:server && npm run lint:server && npm run test:server && npm run build:server
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:server
scripts.build:game: npm run build --workspace @frontier-isles/game-core && npm run build --workspace @frontier-isles/game-ai
scripts.check:game: npm run build:game && npm run check:core && npm run check:ai
scripts.check:core: npm run typecheck --workspace @frontier-isles/game-core && npm run lint --workspace @frontier-isles/game-core && npm run test --workspace @frontier-isles/game-core && npm run build --workspace @frontier-isles/game-core
scripts.check:ai: npm run typecheck --workspace @frontier-isles/game-ai && npm run lint --workspace @frontier-isles/game-ai && npm run test --workspace @frontier-isles/game-ai && npm run build --workspace @frontier-isles/game-ai
